  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryIssue" name="Delivery issue report"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShippingConfirmation" name="Shipping confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FeedbackRequest" name="Feedback follow-up email" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FeedbackRequest"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReturnedItems" name="Return items" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" messageRef="Message_ReturnedItems"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickItems" name="Pick in-stock items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_QualityCheck" name="Perform quality control checks"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockMerge_Pick" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pick_Quality" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_QualityCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quality_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Task_QualityCheck" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${giftWrappingRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrap_Complete" sourceRef="Task_GiftWrap" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrapMerge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_Shipping" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shipping_InternationalGateway" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_International"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_International_Yes" name="International" sourceRef="Gateway_International" targetRef="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customs_Complete" sourceRef="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomsMerge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationJoin_Dispatch" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_Dispatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dispatch_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_Dispatch" targetRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_UpdateInventory" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateInventory_ConfirmDelivery" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmDelivery_Feedback" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_End" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="End_Fulfillment"/>
  </bpmn:process>
